title: CBR What Not Do
description: Lists the mistakes to avoid in each type of event, such as going outside to look, running fans, stockpiling antibiotics, taking potassium iodide without direction, and using hair conditioner after exposure. Also covers spreading misinformation, plastic-bag masks, and keeping a room sealed too long.
shortDescription: Common mistakes during chemical, biological, and radiological events
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
